name: Dishwater Nell
text: Start of Turn: swap your shop's lowest-tier unit for one of your tier. If that's 2+ tiers up and this touches an Ooze, get 1 gold.
golden_text: Start of Turn: swap your shop's 2 lowest-tier units for ones of your tier. If one is 2+ tiers up and this touches an Ooze, get 2 gold.
details: The new unit is random. Only your first Nell pays.
